blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu City has yet to identify an alternative landfill as its budget for garbage disposal in Aloguinsan is projected to run out by early December. To sustain waste hauling operations through the end of the year, the city government is requesting nearly P100 million in supplemental funding from the City Council. […]...
